sources.title: OpenAI 推出將複雜評估簡化為是、否或單選的 Decisions API / OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 推出將複雜評估簡化為是、否或單選的 Decisions API
sources.title_en: OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one
sources.title_original: OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one
sources.summary: OpenAI's new Decisions API classifies text and images about ten times faster than the Responses API, returning yes/no probabilities, category picks, or scale ratings for $0.10 per million input tokens. The company also cut its paid API tiers from five to three. The article OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI's 推出的全新 Decisions API 對文字和圖像的分類速度比 Responses API 快了大約十倍，能以每百萬個輸入權杖 0.10 美元的價格傳回是/否機率、類別選擇或量表評分。該公司也將付費 API 層級從五個削減為三個。本文〈OpenAI 推出將複雜評估簡化為是、否或單選的 Decisions API〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Google 押註 Gemini 透過全新的 Playground 功能將休閒玩家轉變為遊戲開發者 / Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature

sources.title: Google 押註 Gemini 透過全新的 Playground 功能將休閒玩家轉變為遊戲開發者 / Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature
sources.title_zh: Google 押註 Gemini 透過全新的 Playground 功能將休閒玩家轉變為遊戲開發者
sources.title_en: Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature
sources.title_original: Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature
sources.summary: Google launched Playground, a browser-based platform that lets users create their own games using nothing but text prompts and no coding skills. The platform runs on Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria. Alongside Playground, Google and Unity announced Unity Spark, a more professional AI tool with a beta planned for 2026. The article Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google 推出 Playground，這是一個基於瀏覽器的平臺，讓使用者僅需使用文字提示詞、無需任何程式設計技能就能建立自己的遊戲。該平臺運行於 Gemini、Nano Banana 和 Lyria。伴隨著 Playground，Google 與 Unity 共同宣佈推出 Unity Spark，這是一款更為專業的 AI 工具，測試版預計於 2026 年推出。文章 Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature 最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Anthropic 讓更多資安團隊能夠使用 Claude，並減少安全限制 / Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions

sources.title: Anthropic 讓更多資安團隊能夠使用 Claude，並減少安全限制 / Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 讓更多資安團隊能夠使用 Claude，並減少安全限制
sources.title_en: Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
sources.title_original: Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
sources.summary: Anthropic is expanding its Cyber Verification Program, giving more security professionals access to Claude models with fewer safety restrictions for penetration testing, malware analysis, and vulnerability research. Anthropic says partners in its predecessor program found at least 129,000 confirmed vulnerabilities from April through July 2026, including more than 33,000 rated high-severity or critical. The article Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在擴大其網路驗證計畫（Cyber Verification Program），讓更多資安專業人員能夠使用 Claude 模型，並放寬安全限制，以便進行滲透測試、惡意軟體分析和漏洞研究。Anthropic 表示，其前身計畫的合作夥伴在 2026 年 4 月至 7 月期間發現了至少 12,9000 個已確認的漏洞，其中超過 33,000 個被評定為高嚴重性或重大漏洞。文章 Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.title_zh: OpenAI 在 GitHub 上拋出 372 個 AI 生成的數學證明，告訴學術界要跟上進度

sources.title_original: OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up
sources.summary: OpenAI has published 372 AI-generated mathematical results on GitHub, including Lean formalizations for machine verification. Each result consumed about three hours of ChatGPT Pro compute on average. But 25 Fields Medal winners warn that mass-producing mathematical truths could destroy fertile ground rather than bring new ideas to life. The article OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 已在 GitHub 上發布了 372 個 AI 生成的數學成果，其中包括用於機器驗證的 Lean 型式化。每個成果平均消耗了大約三小時的 ChatGPT Pro 算力。但 25 位菲爾茲獎得主警告稱，大量生產數學真理可能會摧毀肥沃的土壤，而不是為新點子賦予生命。這篇文章 OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up 最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_zh: 維基媒體證實 OpenAI's 失控的 AI 代理編輯了維基百科、試圖破壞工具並癱瘓其基礎設施
sources.title_en: Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure
sources.title_original: Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure
sources.summary: According to the Wikimedia Foundation, rogue OpenAI agents edited wikis without permission, tried to abuse a citation tool as a proxy, and may have caused a partial Wikidata Query Service outage through massive crawling. Wikimedia says AI companies need to take responsibility for their agents instead of pushing the burden onto volunteer editors. The article Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據維基媒體基金會（Wikimedia Foundation）指出，失控的 OpenAI 代理未經許可編輯了維基百科、試圖濫用引用工具作為代理伺服器，並可能透過大規模爬蟲導致 Wikidata 查詢服務部分中斷。維基媒體表示，AI 公司必須為其代理負起責任，而不是將負擔推給志願編輯者。這篇題為「Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure」的文章首先發布於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Google 宣稱 EmbeddingGemma 2 的效能超越體積大上一倍的競爭向量模型 / Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size

sources.title: Google 宣稱 EmbeddingGemma 2 的效能超越體積大上一倍的競爭向量模型 / Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size
sources.title_zh: Google 宣稱 EmbeddingGemma 2 的效能超越體積大上一倍的競爭向量模型
sources.title_en: Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size
sources.title_original: Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size
sources.summary: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model with 740 million parameters that converts text, images, video, audio, and code into vectors. It runs on-device, needs only about 191 MB of RAM, and outperforms some competing models twice its size, according to Google. Paired with a small open model like Gemma 4, it can run offline RAG apps without sending data to external servers. The article Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據 Google 指出，Google 推出了 EmbeddingGemma 2，這是一個擁有 7.4 億個參數的開放模型，能將文字、圖片、影片、音訊和程式碼轉換為向量。它可在裝置上執行，僅需約 191 MB 的記憶體，且效能超越某些體積大上一倍的競爭模型。搭配像 Gemma 4 這樣的小型開放模型，它可以在不需要將資料傳送至外部伺服器的情況下執行離線 RAG 應用程式。文章〈Google 宣稱 EmbeddingGemma 2 的效能超越體積大上一倍的競爭向量模型〉（The Decoder）率先報導。

sources.summary: Google's new Nano Banana 2.1 image model uses Gemini 3.6 Flash and beats the previous Pro model in some benchmarks at a lower cost. But its predecessor also scored well in tests, while Pro often produced better images in practice. The article Google's new image model Nano Banana 2.1 generates better images for less money appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.title_en: Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade
sources.title_original: Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade
sources.summary: Microsoft published a bearish AI outlook from Nobel economist Daron Acemoglu. He predicts about 1.5 percent GDP growth over ten years and at most five percent of jobs replaced. Bigger models won't move the needle, he argues. What's missing are practical apps that change how work gets done. The article Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 微軟 發表了諾貝爾經濟學獎得主達倫・艾塞默魯（Daron Acemoglu）對人工智慧抱持的悲觀看法。他預測，未來十年的 GDP 成長率大約為 1.5%，且最多隻有百分之五的工作被取代。他認為，更大的模型無法帶來實質改變。真正缺乏的是能夠改變工作方式的實用應用程式。這篇題為 微軟 的文章最先發表在 The Decoder 上。

stories.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰

sources.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
sources.title_zh: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
sources.title_original: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
sources.summary: 製造業推動後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型，面臨的問題不只是更換加密演演算法。網路安全業者Forescout從營運技術（OT）環境分析PQC轉型，指出OT環境的密碼學機制不只用於保護網路連線，也分佈在韌體數位簽章、安全開機及裝置身分等功能。企業因此需要找出既有裝置及系統使用哪些密碼學機制，並確認這些機制能否升級；無法升級的裝置，未來可能需要採取額外防護措施甚至汰換。

sources.title_original: 維基媒體揭露OpenAI代理未授權活動，大規模抓取與工具探測加重伺服器負擔
sources.summary: 維基媒體基金會（Wikimedia Foundation）調查發現，旗下網站出現多起疑似由OpenAI操作的AI代理活動，包括未經社群核准編輯維基網站、探測公開協作筆記工具Etherpad，以及大量抓取維基媒體資料。相關代理曾向公開資料介面發出數百萬次自動化要求、抓取數百萬個頁面，並對Wikidata查詢服務送出數十萬次查詢。維基媒體認為，相關流量可能是今年5月Wikidata查詢服務部分中斷的影響因素之一。

sources.title: 大映科技運用AI加速IoT網路封包分析，處理500MB資料量所需時間可從4小時縮至10幾分鐘

sources.title_original: 大映科技運用AI加速IoT網路封包分析，處理500MB資料量所需時間可從4小時縮至10幾分鐘
sources.summary: 近日大映科技揭露AI網路封包分析系統ANMAS（AI Network Malware Analysis System）的最新發展，並攜手多方夥伴拓展IoT、OT與企業網路安全等應用。除了供應鏈檢測與場域合作，大映科技總經理劉得民也進一步說明ANMAS如何將AI運用於網路封包分析。 關於ANMAS的實際運作，劉得民指出，IoT設備的網路封包一般可透過交換器或Wi-Fi等方式取得，ANMAS則採用虛擬Wi-Fi環境擷取設備通訊流量，之後再由工程師將封包擷取（Packet Capture，PCAP）檔案送交系統，由AI模型進一步分析。

stories.title: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關

sources.title: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
sources.title_zh: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
sources.title_original: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
sources.summary: 資安院新任院長龔化中上任至今已有兩個月，最近公開「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖，主張以AI對抗AI。四項重點工作搭配六大中心的時程與數字，勾勒出臺灣資安防線下一版的樣貌，其中最受矚目的一場AI紅隊演練，預計明年四月登場。 AI攻擊速度加快，國家資安防禦必須重新設計 龔化中在8月1日開始擔任資安院院長，10月5日首度對外說明上任兩個月來的工作方向，公佈「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖。這套新架構的核心很明確：面對AI帶來的新型攻擊，防守方不能再只靠人工分析與既有流程應對，必須把AI納入國家資安防禦體系，讓攻擊與防禦雙方進入新的競爭階段。

sources.title_zh: Sierra、Meta推Personal Agent Protocol，規範AI代理人存取企業服務
sources.title_original: Sierra、Meta推Personal Agent Protocol，規範AI代理人存取企業服務
sources.summary: 企業AI新創Sierra週二（10/6）宣佈，正與Meta及Walmart、Shopify、Stripe等業者共同開發Personal Agent Protocol，建立個人AI代理人存取企業網站、API及服務的開放標準。 隨著個人AI代理人開始替使用者購物、訂票、預約及處理客服需求，企業也面臨新的存取問題。目前許多代理人仍像真人一樣操作網站或App，透過載入頁面、點選按鈕及填寫表單完成任務，但企業往往無法清楚判斷來訪者是真人、受使用者授權的AI代理人，還是未經許可的自動化程式，也難以掌握代理人究竟獲得哪些許可權。

sources.title_en: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
sources.title_original: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
sources.summary: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.
sources.summary_zh: 在計畫於 2027 年進行首次公開募股（IPO）之前，獲得 Nvidia 支持的 Lambda 正在進行高達 40 億美元的融資，募資前估值達 145 億美元，本輪融資由 Coatue 與 Blackstone 領投。

sources.title_en: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
sources.title_original: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
sources.summary: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.
sources.summary_zh: 個人 AI 代理承諾為你購物、預訂航班和訂位。然而，蓄意的阻擋與反機器人防禦機制卻成為絆腳石，讓消費者夾在中間動彈不得。一項新標準旨在提供協助。

primary_item.summary_zh: 個人 AI 代理承諾為你購物、預訂航班和訂位。然而，蓄意的阻擋與反機器人防禦機制卻成為絆腳石，讓消費者夾在中間動彈不得。一項新標準旨在提供協助。

stories.title: Meta AI 開源 Rebalancer：一個每天執行約 4000 萬個放置問題的 C++ 指派求解器 / Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day

sources.title: Meta AI 開源 Rebalancer：一個每天執行約 4000 萬個放置問題的 C++ 指派求解器 / Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day
sources.title_zh: Meta AI 開源 Rebalancer：一個每天執行約 4000 萬個放置問題的 C++ 指派求解器
sources.title_en: Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day
sources.title_original: Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day
sources.summary: Meta has open-sourced Rebalancer, the C++ and Python library it has used for over 9 years to place shards, servers and traffic. It handles about 40 million assignment problems a day, using local search or MIP solvers like Gurobi, FICO Xpress and HiGHS. It is pip-installable under Apache 2.0. The post Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Meta 已開源其使用超過 9 年的 C++ 與 Python 庫 Rebalancer，用於配置分片、伺服器和流量。它每天處理約 4000 萬個指派問題，使用區域搜尋或 MIP 求解器，例如 Gurobi、FICO Xpress 和 HiGHS。它可在 Apache 2.0 授權下透過 pip 安裝。這篇文章 Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day 最早發布於 MarkTechPost。

It extends a run of breakthroughs that have both impressed and unsettled parts of the mathematical community while raising questions about research ethics and […]

stories.title: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0

sources.title: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0
sources.title_en: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0
sources.title_original: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0
sources.summary: Release: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI released their new Jev-style Decisions API , as previously announced at last week's DevDay. Since I already have an llm-typesafe plugin for talking to Jev, I had GPT-6 Astra read the new OpenAI API documentation and build an llm-openai-decisions plugin inspired by llm-typesafe . Unlike Jev, the new gpt-6-luna decision model supports image input in addition to text. Both models charge for input it and not for output: OpenAI's is 10 cents per million input tokens, Jev's is 4.2 cents per million. Otherwise the API shape is very similar to Jev, at least conceptually. Jev supports three question types for yes/no, choices, or scores. OpenAI Decisions supports the same three types. Install the plugin like this: llm install llm-openai-decisions Here's an example query against an image attachment: llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' And example output: { "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } Consult the README for full details of how to run the other types of questions. Tags: openai , llm , coding-agents , jev
sources.summary_zh: 發布：llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI 發布了他們全新的 Jev 風格 Decisions API，正如上週 DevDay 上所預告的那樣。由於我已經有一個用於與 Jev 對話的 llm-typesafe 外掛程式，我讓 GPT-6 Astra 讀取了新的 OpenAI API 檔案，並建構了一個受 llm-typesafe 啟發的 llm-openai-decisions 外掛程式。與 Jev 不同，新的 gpt-6-luna 決策模型除了支援文字外還支援影像輸入。兩個模型都對輸入收費，不對輸出收費：OpenAI's 為每百萬輸入代幣 10 美分，Jev 為每百萬 4.2 美分。除此之外，API 的形式與 Jev 非常相似，至少在概念上是如此。Jev 支援三種問題類型：是/否、選擇或分數。OpenAI Decisions 支援相同的三種類型。安裝此前掛程式指令如下：llm install llm-openai-decisions 以下是對影像附件進行查詢的範例：llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' 範例輸出：{ "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } 請查閱 README 以瞭解執行其他類型問題的完整詳細資訊。標籤：openai, llm, coding-agents, jev

stories.title: 在維基媒體專案中發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理程式活動 / OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects

sources.title: 在維基媒體專案中發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理程式活動 / OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
sources.title_zh: 在維基媒體專案中發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理程式活動
sources.title_en: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
sources.title_original: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
sources.summary: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects Given how tempting a target wikis are for rogue agent swarms, it's not a huge surprise that Wikipedia found evidence of that activity once they went looking: The Wikimedia Foundation conducted its own investigation to see whether Wikimedia websites had been similarly affected by AI agents, focusing on those operated by OpenAI. We can confirm that we have discovered some activity by these “rogue” OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The unauthorized bot activities included edits to our wikis, some unsuccessful attempts to exploit a public note-taking tool we host, and heavy traffic, which are described more below. They found evidence of agents editing sandbox pages, trying to use pieces of infrastructure such as Etherpad to help proxy content from elsewhere, and saw widespread crawling and "hundreds of thousands of data queries" to their Wikidata Query Service. My best guess is that most of this was a similar (or the same) swarm of agents as those that defaced that German wiki while training for research tasks. The Wikipedia sandbox wiki edits appear to have started on May 12th, and the initial test edits to the UseModWiki Sandbox page reported by that incident started on May 11th. Tags: wikimedia , wikipedia , wikis , ai , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , accidental-cyberattacks
sources.summary_zh: 在維基媒體專案上發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理活動 鑑於維基對於惡意代理蜂群來說是多麼誘人的目標，維基百科在尋找時發現此類活動的證據也就不足為奇了：維基媒體基金會進行了自己的調查，以瞭解維基媒體網站是否受到 AI 代理的類似影響，重點關注由 OpenAI 營運的代理。我們可以確認，我們已在維基媒體平臺上發現了這些「惡意」OpenAI 代理的一些活動。未授權的機器人活動包括對我們的維基進行編輯、一些對我們所主機之公開筆記工具進行漏洞利用的未成功嘗試，以及大量流量，詳情如下所述。他們發現了代理編輯沙盒頁面、試圖使用諸如 Etherpad 之類的基礎設施元件來協助代理來自其他地方的內容的證據，並在其維基資料查詢服務（Wikidata Query Service）中看到了廣泛的爬取和「數十萬次資料查詢」。我最好的猜測是，其中大部分與在訓練研究任務時塗改那個德國維基的代理群體相似（或就是同一個）。維基百科沙盒維基編輯似乎始於 5 月 12 日，該事件報告的對 UseModWiki 沙盒頁面的初始測試編輯始於 5 月 11 日。標籤：wikimedia、wikipedia、wikis、ai、generative-ai、llms、ai-ethics、accidental-cyberattacks

sources.title: Mistral AI 發布 Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)：1.05 兆參數多模態 MoE 模型 / Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model

sources.title_original: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
sources.summary: Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, as a public preview. It is a 1.05 trillion parameter Mixture of Experts model with 49 billion active parameters, native image input, and a 1 million token context window, trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. The API is live now; open weights ship end of October 2026. The post Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Mistral AI 已發布綽號為 Le Chonk 的 Mistral Large 4 進行公開預覽。這是一個擁有 1.05 兆引數的混合專家（MoE）模型，具備 490 億個活躍引數、原生影象輸入以及 100 萬個 Token 的上下文視窗，並在 Mistral's 位於歐洲的資料中心使用 3,800 個 輝達 Grace Blackwell GPU 進行訓練。API 現已上線；開源權重將於 2026 年 10 月底發布。這篇題為「Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model」的文章首先發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title_original: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
items.summary: Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, as a public preview. It is a 1.05 trillion parameter Mixture of Experts model with 49 billion active parameters, native image input, and a 1 million token context window, trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. The API is live now; open weights ship end of October 2026. The post Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Mistral AI 已發布綽號為 Le Chonk 的 Mistral Large 4 進行公開預覽。這是一個擁有 1.05 兆引數的混合專家（MoE）模型，具備 490 億個活躍引數、原生影象輸入以及 100 萬個 Token 的上下文視窗，並在 Mistral's 位於歐洲的資料中心使用 3,800 個 輝達 Grace Blackwell GPU 進行訓練。API 現已上線；開源權重將於 2026 年 10 月底發布。這篇題為「Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model」的文章首先發布於 MarkTechPost。
